episodes.title: The Unstoppable Yawn
episodes.summary: With the greatest father-son battle on earth concluded, Baki experiences overwhelming boredom. Meanwhile, Tokugawa advances his unprecedented experiment.

episodes.title: THE BEAT
episodes.summary: As the other martial artists battle restlessness, Kaoru Hanayama asks Tokugawa for a favor. Deep underground, the cloning project enters its final phase.

episodes.title: The Countenance of Musashi
episodes.summary: As Professor John accepts Sabuko's arcane methods against scientific reasoning, Hanayama gears up for an all-out fistfight with Yujiro on Tokyo's streets.

episodes.title: Boy
episodes.summary: After facing Japan's greatest modern swordsman, the peerless Musashi Miyamoto demands the most skilled fighters in the country. Baki steps forward.

episodes.title: Otherworldly Strength
episodes.summary: Baki unleashes his fastest strike — but the samurai is faster. Later, as Musashi roams the city, his actions catch the attention of other martial artists.

episodes.title: Real Sword
episodes.summary: The first to move is Doppo Orochi. After a brief tussle, he asks Musashi to use a real blade. How will God's Hand fare against the sword saint's steel?

episodes.title: Feather
episodes.summary: Sea King Retsu arrives to face Musashi and trains intensively under the watchful eye of Sea Emperor Kaku to master the secret technique: Xiaoli.

episodes.title: You Are Defeated!
episodes.summary: The battle between kenpo master Retsu and sword master Musashi Miyamoto begins! While Retsu unleashes long-range weapon attacks, Musashi closes in!?

episodes.title: Sea King Retsu
episodes.summary: Barely standing after Musashi's barrage of brutal attacks, Retsu forces his broken body forward and adopts a familiar stance. Can he turn the tide?

episodes.title: Sekigahara
episodes.summary: The deathmatch between Retsu and Musashi comes to a devastatingly brutal conclusion. Baki visits Izo Motobe for guidance and flies into a rage.

episodes.title: Buddy
episodes.summary: After defeating Japan's kendo champ, Musashi faces jujutsu master Goki Shibukawa, who greets the samurai with a firm handshake — and a punch to the face.

episodes.title: Tough Body
episodes.summary: The strongest being on Earth clashes with the strongest samurai in history at the Tokugawa estate! Yujiro demands Musashi face him with two swords.

episodes.title: Practical Fighter
episodes.summary: Jack Hammer arrives at the Tokugawa estate hoping to fight Musashi, but first must defeat Motobe, who's determined to be the next to take on the samurai.

episodes.title: Pickle
episodes.summary: To prevent further chaos, Pickle is sedated and brought to the Skytree lab. Musashi shocks everyone by slapping the prehistoric man in the face.

episodes.title: Death Match
episodes.summary: Tokugawa reunites Musashi with his legendary blade and meets with a resolute Motobe. Meanwhile, Pickle starves himself for the upcoming match.

episodes.title: The Beast and the Warrior
episodes.summary: The Sengoku era's strongest swordsman clashes with the Cretaceous' mightiest warrior — but what happens when Pickle himself takes up a sword?

episodes.title: Protection
episodes.summary: At last, Motobe sees the culmination of his years of training. He throws every trick from the Sengoku period at Musashi to protect his comrades.

episodes.title: Cutting off the Country
episodes.summary: After Musashi "slashes" the host on national TV, the Japanese police move to apprehend him. The samurai leaves the Tokugawa mansion and begins a rampage.

episodes.title: Un-Severable
episodes.summary: The bloodbath continues as Musashi cuts through a platoon of the police's elite. Meanwhile, the President of the USA prepares for a meeting with Yujiro.

episodes.title: For the Country
episodes.summary: Musashi continues to resist, leaving a mountain of bodies in his wake. Later, Police Commissioner Utsumi asks one unlikely person to fight for the nation.

episodes.title: The Scar and The Sword
episodes.summary: In Shinjuku, Hanayama stares into endless darkness and takes his signature stance. As he swings, Musashi seems blinded by his pure fighting spirit...

episodes.title: That Man, Hanayama
episodes.summary: Punching, pinning, crushing — Hanayama throws everything he has at Musashi. But can his iron muscles withstand every cut, slice and rip Musashi inflicts?

episodes.title: Eliminate
episodes.summary: Baki resolves to eradicate the samurai from this world and hones his body at a dojo. Meanwhile, Musashi prepares for the match with a visit to the sewers.

episodes.title: Exquisite Skill
episodes.summary: The day of the showdown arrives. Before this once-in-a-lifetime match begins, an unimaginable sight unfolds before Musashi. Baki is ready to let loose.

episodes.title: The Way of the Sword
episodes.summary: Musashi retaliates brutally, proving that even barehanded, he is unmatched under heaven. But Baki will not back down until he buries the samurai.
